title: Safety Coupler Pin 316 Stainless Steel D Type Shaft Locking Pin For Table Saw Truck Boat Trailer 4.8x50mm/0.19x1.97in
body_html: 1、[Sturdy Stainless Steel] The safety coupler pin is made from 316 stainless steel, which has high strength, sturdy in structure, anti rusty and erosion, ensuring long lasting use. 2、[Reasonable Construction] Reasonably constructed, the shaft locking pin is very convenient to use, remains securely in place without loosening during use. 3、[Versatile Application] The trailer coupler pin is suitable for various uses, such as table saws, lawn care, gardening, trucks, boats, trailers, and other locking applications. 4、[Wire Lock Pin] This is a wire lock pin, equipped with a wire loop that passes through the end of the pin and secures to another post on the other end. 5、[Easy Fixing and Removal] The wire lock pin can easily slide over the post, making it simple to secure and detach, enhancing convenience.Item Type: Safety Coupler PinMaterial: 316 Stainless SteelWeight: Approx. 18-30g / 0.63-1.06oz1 x Safety Coupler Pin31112500242
